items.title: Roger Mitchell Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: Interviewer mentions: 'they loved Claiborne Williams, some from Donaldsonville.' Interviewee responds: 'He was all right.'

ctx.x: on this side of banking i had a good friend dr coco yeah dr coco yeah he's the one that took my little brother's tonsils out yeah yeah well he used to he used to come over there and bump by me man because he never did associate with everybody you know what i mean i mean i was so nice and from a nice family because my sister and them would stand on this side be brown butchie in the market and trimmy market well uh they'll stand on this side and on that side the little single house what he had i know rullier was…
remember sanders too i know yeah yeah yeah i said all that

And after, like they used to give the dancers a long time ago that we know, and they had all the top bands used to come there and play. And like when we'd come in town, that was in 1929 when we'd give a dance and bagged up, and like I said before, they loved Claiborne Williams, some from Donaldsonville.
